description: Lists the APIs on Datacircle's sheet and the number of plans and providers for each. Pass an API's name to search_plans. It takes no arguments and gives the whole sheet in one answer, every API in the sheet's order, with no paging: each API's name (api), how many plans (plans) and providers (providers) it has, its sheet (sheetPage) and, where it has one, its best page (bestPage), which ranks its providers on our benchmark. Call it first when you don't know an API's name; when you do, call search_plans with it straight away. Free, no key, read-only.
name: list_apis

apis.description: Every API on the sheet, in its order.

api.description: The API's name, the api search_plans takes.

bestPage.description: The API's best page on datacircle.dev, which ranks its providers on our benchmark. Left out where it has none.

plans.description: How many plans the API has on the sheet.

sheetPage.description: The API's sheet on datacircle.dev: its plans and their prices.

title: List the APIs
